title: Ninfer on a 5090 & Qwen3.8 27B w/ Vision any tips for it to have decent context?
body: From my research vision is kinda not usable with large context window. Any hacks? This is my setup: command: > ninfer-serve /models/qwen3_8_27b_nvfp4.ninfer --model-id qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4 --host 0.0.0.0 --max-context 252928 --kv-capacity auto --kv-dtype int8 --max-concurrency 2 --spec mtp --draft-tokens 3 --lm-head-draft THANK YOU!!! submitted by /u/Rollingsound514 [link] [comments]
